name: GROMACS GUI v4.3.0 - Full Executable Release
body:
## GROMACS GUI v4.3.0 - STABLE RELEASE

### ATTENTION: Download the Executable Package Below!

The **Source code (zip)** and **Source code (tar.gz)** assets are auto-generated by GitHub and contain ONLY the Python source code (less than 1 MB). They CANNOT be run directly.

Please download the **GROMACS_GUI_v4.3.0_Release.zip** asset below (176 MB). This is the complete runnable program.

---

### What's Included in the Executable Package

- **GROMACS_GUI_v4.3.0.exe** - Main executable (90 MB)
- **Python 3.13 runtime** - Bundled, no separate Python installation needed
- **PyQt5 framework** - Bundled GUI framework
- **All dependencies** (numpy, psutil, etc.) - Bundled
- **Launch script** (`start.bat`) - One-click startup
- **Uninstall script** (`uninstall.bat`) - Clean removal
- **User manual** (Chinese PDF + MD)

### What's NOT Included

- **GROMACS engine** (gmx.exe) - Must be installed separately
  - Download from: https://manual.gromacs.org/
  - Supported versions: 2025.1, 2026.x
  - Place in `gromacs/` subfolder OR specify path in Settings

### System Requirements

| Item | Required |
|------|----------|
| OS | Windows 10/11 (64-bit) |
| Python | 3.13 (bundled) |
| GROMACS | 2025.1 or 2026.x (separate install) |
| GPU | NVIDIA GPU + CUDA 13.0+ (OPTIONAL) |
| RAM | 8 GB minimum |
| Disk | 2 GB for GUI + GROMACS installation |

### Installation

1. Download `GROMACS_GUI_v4.3.0_Release.zip` (176 MB)
2. Extract to ANY directory (e.g., `D:\GROMACS_GUI_v4.3.0`)
3. Install GROMACS separately
4. Double-click `start.bat` to launch
5. In the GUI: Settings > GROMACS Path to configure GROMACS location

### No GPU? No Problem!

The software automatically detects NVIDIA GPU presence:
- **With GPU**: GPU acceleration enabled
- **Without GPU**: Auto-switches to pure CPU mode, all features still work
